messages:
ops-bot: Incident declared: edge-lb cross-region retries spike detected (auto-detected by probe-correlation).
sara-ng: Seeing retries up ~4x for some regions, but only on flows that hit TLS renegotiation path. short window around 11:07 UTC.
mike-choi: I pulled the logs. TLS handshake errors correlate with a config roll earlier (rollout-1572) + a small spike in route churn.
olivia-k: adding notes from postmortem draft: possible double-apply of sni-policy during rollout, clients retried -> connection storm.
cheng-li: repro attempt: ran synthetic probe from eu-west -> us-east, saw 502 then retries. curl log:
```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood.example/health
* Connected to lb-eu (35.45.23.10) port 443
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLS handshake error: unexpected message
* Closing connection
```
ashley: assigning action items, keeping short. we should track ownership and timelines here.
sara-ng: Action A: Confirm whether rollout-1572 included the sni-policy patch. Owner: @mike-choi. ETA: 24h.
mike-choi: Ack. I'll diff the applied config vs. canary. Filing ticket NET-3124 and will attach diffs.
olivia-k: Action B: Add a short-lived synthetic canary that probes TLS renegotiation path for cross-region flows. Owner: @olivia-k. ETA: 48h. I'll add alert thresholds to paging if >3x baseline.
cheng-li: Action C: Add KV cache guard to LB runtime to avoid double-apply when zone-sync overlap occurs. Owner: @cheng-li. ETA: 1 week. Filing RFC and draft patch in NET-3125.
ashley: Action D: Short-term mitigation: increase client backoff multiplier for region-to-region retries in edge policy. Owner: @sara-ng. ETA: 6h emergency config.
sara-ng: I'll push the backoff override as hotfix to avoid overload while we triage.
mike-choi: Observability item: correlate probe timestamps with route ADJ events. Owner: @mike-choi. ETA: 72h. I'll add a dashboard card and a logql query.
olivia-k: Recurring pattern note: this looks like the same class of incidents we've seen in 3 prior months where routing churn + TLS rekey caused retry storms. Recommend: persistent metric for "tls-handshake-retry-rate" tagged by rollout-id.
sara-ng: Agree. Add as Action E: Persist metric + alert. Owner: @ashley. ETA: 1 week.
ashley: Will do. Also scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to walk through NET-3124/3125 and decide postmortem owners.
mike-choi: FYI: temporary mitigation will likely drop 5-10% of traffic for a few mins while we flip backoff, but keeps backend healthy.
cheng-li: I'll start the RFC draft now. Putting notes in NET-3125 and will ping when review-ready.
olivia-k: Can we also add a small header to logs to surface rollout-id for future correlating? small change in ingress logging. Owner: @mike-choi. ETA: 3 days.
sara-ng: Good. Summary for the thread: owners & ETAs logged (NET-3124, NET-3125). Hotfix in progress (6h). Canary + alert (48-72h). RFC & metric (1w). We'll update this thread after the hotfix and again after the sync. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Severity: Sev2. Updates will be posted in this thread."
